Arbeite dort, wo andere Ferien machen!
 Dipl. Pflegefachperson HF/FH mit Fallführung (80-100%)
 Kannst du es dir vorstellen, in einem kleinen Team ohne direkte Führungsperson zu arbeiten? Wir haben unsere Organisationsform auf teil-autonome Teams umgestellt, das heisst, wir orientieren uns an dem berühmten Buurtzorg-Modell, haben es aber auf unsere Bedürfnisse angepasst. In einem interdisziplinären Team, mit Fallführenden, FaGes und Hauswirtschafts- und Betreuungsmitarbeitenden an deiner Seite soll es eine neue Form des Arbeitens sein, die zeitgemäss ist und nötige Flexibilität, aber auch Struktur und Kontinuität ermöglicht.
 Du verfügst über folgende Qualifikationen:

• abgeschlossene Ausbildung zur dipl. Pflegefachperson HF/FH

• idealerweise Spitex-Erfahrung

• ausgeprägte Fach- und Sozialkompetenz

• selbstständige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise

Du betreust unsere Kundinnen und Kunden ganzheitlich und ressourcenorientiert.

Lavorare dove gli altri vanno in vacanza!
Infermiera HF/FH con gestione dei casi (80-100%)
Riesci a immaginare di lavorare in una piccola squadra senza un capo diretto? Abbiamo convertito la nostra forma organizzativa a squadre semiautonome, cioè siamo guidati dal famoso modello Buurtzorg, ma l'abbiamo adattato alle nostre esigenze. In un team interdisciplinare, con case manager, FaGes e personale di pulizia e supporto al vostro fianco, dovrebbe essere una nuova forma di lavoro che è contemporaneo e permette la flessibilità necessaria, ma anche la struttura e la continuità.
Hai le seguenti qualifiche:

• Allenamento completato per il dipl. Professionista HF/FH

• Esperienza ideale Spitex

• Forti competenze professionali e sociali

• pratiche di lavoro autonome e responsabili

• valido categoria B biglietto
I vostri compiti: Come dipendente responsabile del caso, si controlla il processo di cura dalla prima visita con la valutazione delle esigenze secondo interRAI fino al completamento. Sei l'interfaccia per la cooperazione interprofessionale con tutte le entità coinvolte, consigliare parenti e professionisti sanitari di accompagnamento così come il team di assistenza. Si prende cura dei nostri clienti in modo olistico e orientato alle risorse.
Vi offriamo:

• un compito vario, responsabile e indipendente in un'organizzazione innovativa;

• condizioni di lavoro flessibili;

• 5 settimane di ferie (da 50 anni 6 settimane);

• prestazioni sociali molto buone (ad esempio contributo del fondo pensione 60:40);

• Un ambiente di lavoro motivante e apprezzabile.

Ti senti indirizzato? Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Work where others go on holiday!
Dipl. Nurse HF/FH with case management (80-100%)
Can you imagine working in a small team without a direct leader? We have converted our organizational form to semi-autonomous teams, i.e. we are guided by the famous Buurtzorg model, but have adapted it to our needs. In an interdisciplinary team, with case managers, FaGes and housekeeping and support staff at your side, it should be a new form of work that is contemporary and allows for the necessary flexibility, but also structure and continuity.
You have the following qualifications:

• Completed training for the dipl. Care professional HF/FH

• Ideally Spitex experience

• Strong professional and social skills

• self-employed and responsible working practices

• valid category B ticket
Your tasks: As a case-leading employee, you control the care process from the first visit with the needs assessment according to interRAI until completion. You are the interface for interprofessional cooperation with all involved entities, advise relatives and accompanying health professionals as well as the care team. You look after our customers holistically and resource-oriented.
We offer you:

• a varied, responsible and independent task in an innovative organisation;

• flexible conditions of employment;

• 5 weeks of holidays (from 50 years of age 6 weeks);

• very good social benefits (e.g. pension fund contribution 60:40);

• A motivating and appreciative working environment.
Do you have any questions? Call us.
Do you feel addressed? We look forward to your application!

Andrea Weber or Nicole Mielisch, team coach

Tel. 043 928 10 20

jobs.description:
Die Stiftung Zentrum im Hof stellt im Auftrag der Gemeinde Greifensee eine umfassende Versorgung in den Bereichen Wohnen und Pflege im Alter sicher. Das moderne und hell gestaltete Haus befindet sich in der Nähe des historischen Städtlis und des Sees. Dem Zentrum angeschlossen sind drei stationäre Pflegewohngruppen mit 28 Bewohnerinnen und Bewohnern sowie 12 altersgerechte Wohnungen. Ebenfalls der Stiftung angegliedert ist die öffentliche Spitex der Gemeinde Greifensee.
 Zur Ergänzung unseres Teams in der Spitex suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine versierte und zuverlässige
 Diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF oder FAGE 40% bis 50 %
 die unsere Klientinnen und Klienten in den Mittelpunkt ihres Engagements stellt.

 Sie pflegen, betreuen und beraten Klientinnen/Klienten in ihrer gewohnten Umgebung ganzheitlich und erhalten, oder fördern damit ihre Selbstständigkeit. Nach einer sorgfältigen Einführung planen Sie den Pflegebedarf und steuern und überwachen den Pflegeprozess. Eine aktive Zusammenarbeit mit Angehörigen und/oder anderen involvierten Fachpersonen gehört ebenso zu Ihrer Aufgabe wie die enge Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Teams.

• Abschluss als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann FH/HF oder FAGE

• Selbständige Arbeitsweise, sowie verantwortungsvolles und engagiertes Handeln

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und EDV-Kenntnisse (Perigon, RAI-HC)

• In Besitz eines Führerausweises, eigenes Auto (Einsätze sind auch mit Velo möglich)

• Wiedereinsteiger sind willkommen
 Wir bieten

• Sorgfältige Einführung

• Ein engagiertes, wertschätzendes Team

• Abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet

• Einen schönen und modern eingerichteten Arbeitsplatz

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Vereinbarkeit Familie – Beruf)

• Mind. fünf Wochen Ferien und gute Sozialleistungen
 Fühlen Sie sich angesprochen? Wir würden Sie gerne kennenlernen. Im persönlichen Gespräch gibt Ihnen Frau Egli gerne Einblick in die interessante Aufgabe.

 Susanne Kleeb, Zentrum «im Hof», im Hof 15, 8606 Greifensee, Tel. 043 366 35 33 susanne.kleeb@zentrumimhof.ch

La casa moderna e luminosa si trova vicino alla città storica e al lago. Collegati al centro sono tre gruppi di alloggi adottivi apatici con 28 residenti e 12 appartamenti adatti all'età. Anche affiliato alla fondazione è il pubblico Spitex del comune di Greifensee. Per completare il nostro team a Spitex, stiamo cercando un esperto e affidabile Infermiera laureata HF o FAGE 40% al 50% che pone i nostri clienti al centro del loro impegno. I loro compiti Mantengono, sostengono e consigliano i clienti in modo olistico nel loro ambiente abituale e quindi mantengono o promuovono la loro indipendenza. Dopo un'introduzione attenta, pianificare le esigenze di cura e controllare e monitorare il processo di cura. On behalf of the municipality of Greifensee, the Stiftung Zentrum im Hof provides comprehensive care in the areas of living and care in old age. The modern and brightly designed house is located near the historic town and lake. Connected to the center are three inpatient foster housing groups with 28 residents and 12 age-appropriate apartments. Also affiliated to the foundation is the public Spitex of the municipality of Greifensee. RegioSpitex Limmattal is an important partner in healthcare
RegioSpitex Limmattal is a modern, future-oriented non-profit organization with around 135 employees, which ensures the hospital external care and care for the inhabitants of Dietikon, Schlieren and Urdorf.
As a supplement to our existing specialists for carers, we are looking for a further
Dipl. Nursing specialist HF/FH with additional function as specialist responsible for carers
Your versatile tasks as a nurse are:

• You work in direct care and take over the advice and guidance of customers, relatives and employees in complex care situations.

• You carry out needs assessments with the instrument InterRAI
(Assumption of the costs of InterRAI training by RegioSpitex Limmattal)

• As a case management, you are responsible for planning and implementing the care process for your customers.

• You play an active role in cooperation with the supervising, interdisciplinary network and coordinate the corresponding services for your customers
Your additional tasks together with a colleague as specialist responsibility for carers are:

• You lead, advise, accompany and promote the carers in professional and social situations, conduct regular location meetings, ensure the flow of information and organize needs-based training.

• You design the entire HR process in cooperation with HR – from recruitment to implementation and offboarding.

• You ensure that the nurses complete the required SRC course within the prescribed time limit and accompany them to put what they have learned into practice.

• You take over the case management of the customers of caregivers including the administrative steps, coordinate the assignment planning and ensure the quality on site.
You bring with you:

• You have a degree as a dipl. Nursing professional HF / FH as well as corresponding professional experience in this area

• You have very good oral and written knowledge of German (level C1)

• You bring experience in the professional support and management of employees as well as strong organizational and coordination skills

• You are an open-minded and flexible personality who likes to approach people

• You bring good communication skills as well as safe handling of mobile care documentation (smartphone)

• You think networked, work independently and responsibly
We offer

• A versatile and challenging workspace where you can use and develop your expertise and experience

• A working environment characterized by respect and appreciation

• A careful introduction to the various home care tasks

• Attractive employment conditions and modern infrastructure

• Freely selectable amount and no shared services

• Generous training and education opportunities

• All employee benefits

• Du-culture at all levels
For further information: Emine Caneve, Head of Care at your disposal.
Please fill in the application form below.
We look forward to seeing you!
Applications from job placements are not considered!

La Spitex-Verein Bärentswil si trova in posizione centrale nell'Oberland di Zurigo e offre cure ambulatoriali e apatie per la comunità con circa 70 dipendenti. Oltre alla cura individuale a casa, operiamo un appartamento di cura per 22 residenti e una cura tutto il giorno. La nostra offerta è completata da pasti e servizi di guida. Come organizzazione, attribuiamo grande importanza alla cura di alta qualità e ad una cooperazione apprezzata.

Per la nostra organizzazione, siamo subito alla ricerca di un supporto amministrativo dedicato, che prende il sopravvento sia nel coordinamento del volontariato che in varie attività amministrative. La posizione è adatta a qualcuno con una mentalità pratica, ama lavorare in modo strutturato e assumersi la responsabilità:
I loro compiti principali

• Coordinamento del volontariato – pianificazione dell'assegnazione, comunicazione, supporto dei volontari

• Organizzazione generale dell'ufficio – deposito, gestione dei documenti, panoramica degli appuntamenti

• Gestione delle corresponsabilità – elaborazione e-mail, contatto telefonico, comunicazione interna

• Manutenzione dei dati – aggiornamento di liste, panoramiche e piani operativi

• Pianificazione iniziale – supporto per preparazione, implementazione e post-elaborazione
Il tuo profilo

• Istruzione commerciale o qualificazione equivalente

• Esperienza professionale nelle attività amministrative

• Forte mentalità hands-on e metodi di lavoro indipendenti

• Godetevi l'organizzazione, la comunicazione e la cooperazione con diversi stakeholder
Offriamo

• Un compito versatile con ambito di progettazione

• Collaborazione in un team impegnato in un ambiente gestibile e apprezzabile.

• Spazio per co-creazione e contributo attivo

• Attività di squadra

• Parcheggio gratuito

• Cibo scontato

Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse?

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Spitex-Verein Bärentswil is centrally located in the Zurich Oberland and offers ambulatory and inpatient care for the community with around 70 employees. In addition to individual care at home, we operate a care apartment for 22 residents and a care round the clock. Our offer is complemented by meal and driving services. As an organization, we attach great importance to high-quality care and an appreciative cooperation.
Employee* in Administration
For our organization, we are immediately looking for a dedicated administrative support, which takes over both in the coordination of volunteer work and various administrative activities. The position is suitable for someone with a hands-on mentality, likes to work in a structured way and take responsibility:
Their main tasks

• Coordination of volunteer work – assignment planning, communication, support of volunteers

• General office organization – filing, document management, appointment overview

• Correspondence management – e-mail processing, telephone contact, internal communication

• Data maintenance – updating lists, overviews and operational plans

• Initial planning – support for preparation, implementation and post-processing
Your profile

• Commercial education or equivalent qualification

• Professional experience in administrative activities

• Strong hands-on mentality and independent working methods

• Enjoy organization, communication and cooperation with different stakeholders
We offer

• A versatile task with design scope

• Collaboration in a committed team in a manageable and appreciative environment.

• Space for co-creation and active contribution

• Team activities

• Free parking

• Discounted food

Have we aroused your interest?
We look forward to your complete application to email bewerbung@spitex-baeretswil.ch
